dedupe_keys.name: comprehensive database of crop distribution in india district and country level 1947 2014 smith ghosh and hijmans

description: Crop area and production data for India at district and country level from 1947 to 2014. The Harvard Dataverse record says country data for 31 crops from 1947 to 1960 come from Indian Statistical Abstracts and FAO Statistical Yearbooks, and FAOSTAT covers 80 crops from 1961 to 2014, while district data combine the India Agriculture and Climate dataset (20 crops, 1956 to 1987) and ICRISAT district data (24 crops in 19 states, 1966 to 2011), processed in R. Version 1.0 was released on 15 August 2019 with tab-separated tables for country area, production and yield (1956 to 2014), country area (1947 to 2014) and interpolated district area, production and yield (1956 to 2008, about 33 MB), plus a shapefile of 1971 district boundaries, all free to download under a custom licence whose terms prohibit redistribution outside the platform. Coverage is India. Caveats: district values are interpolated, boundaries are fixed at 1971, and the district series stops in 2008. For simulation it gives a long record of where each crop is grown and how much, to estimate crop exposure to floods, droughts and cyclones by district and the loads on storage and transport. A related catalogue record is the India crop insurance (PMFBY) portal dashboard.
